lang.title: TRX Console language
lang.not_saved: Language changed for this session only (cannot write {path}).

stop_for_exclusive_use.1: The station is running: it will be stopped during {why}.
assistant.1: Reusing the configuration imported from the old PC ({imported}).
assistant.2: The wizard did not finish: nothing was changed.
indicator.1: Desktop without GNOME (or gnome-extensions tool missing): the indicator only exists for GNOME for now.
indicator.2: Indicator missing ({gnome_extension_dir}): install version 0.49.0 or later (menu 6.3).
indicator.3:
The indicator is installed but GNOME does not know it yet: log out and log back in,
then come back to this menu.
indicator.4:
The indicator shows at the top of the screen, left of the sound icon: a light (green receive, red transmit,
orange alert, grey station stopped, purple safe mode), the frequency or the transmission countdown,
and on click the full status (clients, transceiver, spectrum, DX Cluster, temperature, update...).
It only READS the station status: it cannot control anything.
State: {v}.
indicator.11: Indicator enabled: it appears at the top right.
indicator.12: Enabling failed (code {code}): log out, log back in and try again.
hwtest.2: Before the test, check the computer's sound:
hwtest.3:
Test on the real transceiver:
  1) receive only (no transmission): CAT, received audio, tuning, filter widths, spectrum scope
  2) full: the same, then transmission (dummy load, reduced power, confirmation at each step)
qualif.2:
Transceiver qualification (trx-qualif), for an expert:
  1) test plan and Hamlib inconsistencies, without touching the transceiver
  2) exploration WITHOUT transmission: everything Hamlib declares is read and compared with the transceiver
     (frequency and a few receive settings changed, then put back)
  3) read-only exploration: nothing is changed on the transceiver
  4) qualification without transmission (verdict "incomplete": the transmission phase is not done)
  5) full qualification, with transmission (dummy load, reduced power, confirmation at each step)
Reports: {path}
start.2: Station started. A diagnostic is advised in a few seconds (menu 2.1).
stop.1: Station stopped (the transceiver stays in receive).
report.2:
Report created: {path}
It contains no password: attach it to your request for help.
clear_safe_mode.1:
Safe mode was triggered by the supervisor after repeated failures.
Check the cause first (menu 2.1 and menu 1.4).
clear_safe_mode.2: The cause is fixed, leave safe mode
update.1: No update check yet (it runs 2 minutes after the station starts).
update.4: TRX distant is up to date (version {installed}). Last check: {checked}.
update.16: To install, type the version number {version} (Enter = no):
update.17: Update cancelled: nothing was changed. It is still offered in menu {update_menu}.
update.18: Version {version} installed. Quit TRX Console (q) and reopen it to use the new version.
show_changes.4: -- Enter: more notes; q: stop here --
rollback.1: No previous version kept: one appears after a first update.
rollback.2:
Active version: {installed}. Previous version kept: {previous}.
Rollback works without Internet; the station is stopped during the operation.
rollback.4: Rolled back to version {previous}. Quit TRX Console (q) and reopen it. The newer version will still be offered in menu 6.1.
install_zip.1:
No « trx-remote-debian-X.Y.Z.zip » package on the Desktop, in Downloads or in the
home folder ({home}). Copy it to one of these places and try again.
install_zip.5: Number of the package to install (Enter = cancel):
install_zip.7:
WARNING: {version} is OLDER than the installed version ({installed}).
To simply go back to the previous version, menu 6.2 is enough.
install_zip.8: Version {version} is already installed: it will be reinstalled.
install_zip.9:
During the installation (a few minutes, Internet required for the Python modules), the station
is stopped. It is refused while the transceiver is transmitting; the package contents are checked before
any installation; version {installed}, station.toml and the certificates are kept.
install_zip.10:
This package is NOT SIGNED: nothing guarantees it comes from the TRX distant team. Install it
only if you copied it yourself from a safe source (your PC, your USB stick).
install_zip.12: To install, type the version number {version} (Enter = no):
install_zip.14: Version {version} installed. Quit TRX Console (q) and reopen it to use the new version.
edit_config.2:
Cannot read {config} ({exc}).
If you were just added to the « trx » group, log out and log back in.
edit_config.3: No text editor found: install nano (sudo apt install nano).
edit_config.4:
Editing {config} (on a copy: nothing changes before you confirm).
In nano: Ctrl+O then Enter to save, Ctrl+X to quit.
edit_config.5: No change: station.toml was not modified.
edit_config.6:
Configuration REFUSED (the station would not start):
  -
profiles.2:
1) Save the current transceiver configuration as a profile
  2) Load a profile (change transceiver)
  3) Delete a profile
  q) Back
list_profiles.1:
A profile keeps what depends on the TRANSCEIVER: model, ports, PTT, sound cards, spectrum. Accounts, network,
allowed bands and safety settings belong to the station: a profile never touches them.
choose_profile.1: Number of the profile to {verb} (Enter = cancel):
save_profile.1: Current configuration invalid or unreadable: fix it first (menu 3.2). ({exc})
save_profile.2: Profile name (e.g. IC-7300 home; Enter = cancel):
save_profile.4: Name refused: 40 characters at most, letters, digits, spaces and - _ . + only.
load_profile.2: Refused: the transceiver is transmitting (or its state is unreadable). Load the profile once it is back in receive.
load_profile.5: Profile in an old format ({format}) converted to format {profile_format}. Check the changes below; then save it again (choice 1) so it no longer needs converting.
load_profile.6: Warning: the transceiver port {port} is missing for now (transceiver off or not plugged in yet?).
load_profile.7: This profile is already the one of the transceiver in use: nothing to change.
load_profile.8: Loading profile « {name} »: only the [rig], [audio] and [spectrum] sections change (station.toml is rewritten in its standard form).
save_config.5: station.toml was modified elsewhere in the meantime: abandoned, start again.
save_config.6: Cannot make a backup copy: station.toml was not modified.
save_config.7: Cannot save (code {code}): station.toml was not modified.
save_config.9: The station picks up these changes by itself within a few seconds (no restart); a disabled or deleted account is disconnected at once.
save_config.11: The changes will apply the next time the station starts (menu 1.1).
swr_report.1: No SWR measurement stored on this station. It is started from the web page or the app (« SWR measurement » section), never from the console.
visitors.3:
1) Settings (maximum number, operator required, wait time, out of band)
  2) Create a visitor account
  3) Edit a visitor account (display name, password, enabled, expiry)
  4) Delete a visitor account
  5) Display name of an operator account (shown to visitors)
  6) Disconnect a connected visitor
  7) Reopen listening suspended by a station overload
Choice (Enter = back):
visitors_summary.1: Receive-only visitors: they listen and see the screen, with NO control over the transceiver.
visitors_summary.7: yes (visitors disconnected {operator_grace_s} s after the operator is lost)
visitors_summary.16: listening closed (the operator opens it from the web page or the app)
visitor_settings.1: Maximum number of visitors connected at the same time (0 = listening closed)
visitor_settings.2: Visitors admitted ONLY if an operator is connected
visitor_settings.3: Wait after the operator is lost before disconnecting visitors, in seconds
visitor_settings.4: Let visitors listen OUTSIDE the station bands (your responsibility)
visitor_settings.5: Visitors' HF spectrum: frames per second at most
ask_pseudo.1: Display name shown to the other connected users ({pseudo_max} characters at most
ask_pseudo.5: {pseudo_max} characters at most, no special characters.
ask_pseudo.6: This is an account login: it would be shown to the other connected users. Choose another display name.
ask_new_password.1: Password (Enter = generate a strong one, - = abandon):
ask_new_password.2:
Password: {answer}
Give it to the visitor now: the station does not keep it in clear text.
pick_account.3: Number of the account to {verb} (Enter = cancel):
visitor_create.1: Visitor login (letters, digits, _ and -, Enter = cancel):
visitor_create.2: Invalid login or already in use.
visitor_create.3: The display name cannot be the login: it would be shown to the other connected users.
visitor_create.4: Warning: visitor listening is CLOSED (maximum number 0): open it with choice 1.
save_accounts.1: No change: station.toml was not modified.
save_accounts.3: (station.toml is rewritten in its standard form.)
visitor_reopen.2: Request sent: the station reopens listening if it is clearly back below the thresholds (otherwise it refuses: see the log, menu 1.4).
visitor_kick.2: Number of the visitor to disconnect (Enter = cancel):
visitor_kick.4: Request sent: the visitor is disconnected within a second (they can reconnect; to prevent it, disable their account, choice 3).
friends.1:
Group presence disabled, or « presence » module never started.
To enable it (menu 3.2): in [presence], enabled = true; in [modules], add
"presence" to run (e.g. run = ["cluster", "presence"]); then restart the station (menu 1.1).
friends.2:
1) Choose the display name
  2) Groups and members
  3) Create a group
  4) Invite someone (link and QR code)
  5) Join a group (paste an invitation)
  6) What I share in a group
  7) Leave or delete a group
Choice (Enter = back):
friends_summary.7: No group: create one (choice 3) or join one (choice 5).
friends_request.3: No answer from the « presence » module (station stopped? see the log, menu 1.4).
friends_pseudo.1: Display name (call sign or nickname, 16 characters: unaccented letters, digits, space, . / _ -):
friends_create.2: Group « {name} » created: you are its administrator. Invite your friends (choice 4).
friends_invite.1:
Invitation valid for 7 days, for ONE station only. Give it only to the invited person
(it contains the group key):
friends_invite.2: Their membership will be validated automatically by your station at its next request.
friends_join.2: Name of this group on your side (Enter = automatic):
friends_join.3: Membership request sent: it is validated as soon as the administrator's station sees it.
friends_share.1: Text (16 characters: unaccented letters, digits, space, . / -):
friends_share.2: Be invisible in this group for now
friends_share.3: Sharing saved: applied at the next request (less than 2 minutes).
friends_leave.1: You are the administrator: DELETE the group for everyone
network.1: Station stopped: no current link to show.
network.2:
1) Summary of the last 24 hours
  2) Summary of the last 30 days
  3) Anonymous export to the Desktop (for the development team)
  4) Erase everything (network history; the chosen thresholds are kept)
Choice (Enter = back):
network.3: No measurement yet: the probe records as soon as a phone or a web page is connected.
network_export.3:
Anonymous export created: {target}
No account, IP address or position: attach it to your message for the development team.
network_clear.1: Erase all network history (outages, statistics, devices seen)? Type {word} to confirm:
network_clear.3: Request sent: the history is erased within a second.
breizh.3:
1) Create or replace the pairing key (to copy into Breizh)
  2) Breizh address and port, enable or disable
  3) Link test (no sound)
  4) Link log
Choice (Enter = back):
breizh_key_state.2: present ({path}; read by the station, not by this account)
breizh_summary.1: Breizh Audio Box: the operator's voice goes through Breizh (another PC on the local network) before the transceiver;
breizh_summary.2: the station keeps the PTT, the TOT and its limiter, and switches back to direct if Breizh stops answering.
breizh_summary.12: Link now              : gateway stopped, or key unreadable at startup (see the log, menu 1.4)
breizh_journal.1: Log of the link with Breizh (most recent at the bottom):
breizh_journal.2: Empty log: the gateway has not recorded anything yet.
breizh_new_key.1: A key already exists: replacing it means copying the new one into Breizh. Replace
breizh_new_key.2: Cannot write ({exc}): run TRX Console again as administrator.
breizh_new_key.4:
Pairing key saved. Copy it NOW into the « OpenRemoteTRX » tab of the Breizh settings (it is never shown again; if lost: create a new one):

    {key_to_text}

In Breizh: address of this station = {v}, UDP port = {port}, then enable OpenRemoteTRX mode (this disables Breizh's CAT).
On the Breizh PC, the firewall must let in UDP {port2} from this station.
breizh_new_key.5: its IP address on the local network
breizh_new_key.6: Restart the station so it takes the new key
breizh_settings.1: IP address of the Breizh PC (127.0.0.1 = this PC; Enter = {v}):
breizh_settings.3: PRIVATE IP address expected (192.168.x.y, 10.x.y.z, 172.16 to 31.x.y, 127.0.0.1…): no name and no public address, the microphone audio travels unencrypted.
breizh_settings.6: Without an address, Breizh cannot be enabled.
breizh_settings.7: Warning: no pairing key yet (choice 1): the station will start WITHOUT Breizh.
breizh_probe.3: The station's link with Breizh is IN USE ({get}, round trip {get2} ms): no need to test. Breizh serves only one station at a time and would answer « busy » to the test. The test is useful when the station is stopped or Breizh is not enabled on it.
temperature.3:
Transceiver temperature (read by Hamlib, TEMP_METER):
  1st threshold (warning: web page and notification)          : {rig_temp_warn_c} °C
  2nd threshold (remote transmit cut, resumes below the 1st)  : {rig_temp_cut_c} °C
No effect if the transceiver does not report its temperature (the IC-7300MK2 under Hamlib).
temperature.6: No change: station.toml was not modified.
ask_degrees.2: A whole number of degrees, for example 45.
expert.1:
Expert menu:
  1) Automatic software tests (pytest, 7 to 10 minutes on a recent PC, 30 minutes or more on a
     small PC; SIMULATED transceiver: no transmission)
  q) Back
run_tests.1: Tests missing from the installed version ({tests}): they are included from version 0.42.0 on.
run_tests.2:
The test tool (pytest) is not installed. Installing it requires Internet and the password
(it is added to the installed version; an update removes it, just reinstall it then).
run_tests.4: Cannot install pytest (Internet?): tests not run.
run_tests.5:
The tests use a SIMULATED transceiver (no command to the real transceiver, no transmission). The station is
stopped during the tests to free its network ports, then restarted if you wish.
run_tests.9: Some tests fail (code {code}). Send this file for analysis: {log}
